title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CUA-Recovery, a benchmark comprising test and training suites across multiple desktop applications.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As computer-use agents (CUAs) move to long-horizon workflows spanning multiple applications, undetected errors can silently corrupt persistent state and cause cascading failures in subsequent actions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across six agents and six takeover depths, Error Awareness Rate (EAR) reaches at most 44.0% and Pass@3 at most 25.5%.
